test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the given options best describes the truthfulness of the following statements?

**Statement - 1 : **It is the duty of the Commission to make recommendations to the President as to the distribution between the Union and the States of the net proceeds of taxes which are to be, or may be, divided between them and the allocation between the States of the respective shares of such proceeds.

**Statement - 2 :** It is the duty of the Commission to make recommendations to the President as to the principles which should govern the grants - in - aid of the revenues of the States out of the Consolidated Fund of India.

options.text: Both statement - 1 and statement - 2 are correct
Both statement - 1 and statement - 2 are incorrect

solution:
The correct answer is **Both statement - 1 and statement - 2 are correct.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement - 1: It is the duty of the Commission to make recommendations to the President as to the distribution between the Union and the States of the net proceeds of taxes which are to be, or may be, divided between them and the allocation between the States of the respective shares of such proceeds:**

 
 
• This statement is correct. The Finance Commission is responsible for making recommendations on the distribution of tax revenues between the central government (Union) and the state governments.
 
• The Commission evaluates the financial needs and capacities of the states and suggests a fair allocation of tax proceeds to ensure balanced development and fiscal stability across the country.
 
 
 
• **Statement - 2: It is the duty of the Commission to make recommendations to the President as to the principles which should govern the grants-in-aid of the revenues of the States out of the Consolidated Fund of India:**
 
 
• This statement is also correct. The Finance Commission advises on the principles that should guide the provision of grants-in-aid to states from the central government’s Consolidated Fund.
 
• These grants are intended to supplement the resources of states to ensure they can provide adequate public services and meet their developmental objectives.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Only statement - 2 is correct:**

 
 
• This option is incorrect because statement - 1 is also correct as per the duties of the Finance Commission.
 
 
 
• **Only statement - 1 is correct:**
 
 
• This option is incorrect because statement - 2 is also correct as per the responsibilities of the Finance Commission.
 
 
 
• **Both statement - 1 and statement - 2 are incorrect:**
 
 
• This option is incorrect because both statements accurately describe the duties of the Finance Commission in relation to the distribution of tax revenues and grants-in-aid.
